title: Arkani-Hamed's positive geometries outside spacetime

tellings.quote: and what they're finding so Nemo was one of the first pioneers in this era um is structures that they call positive geometries outside of spaceime.

plain: Donald Hoffman, a scientist who studies perception, says on Jesse Michels's podcast in 2026 that physicists such as Nima Arkani-Hamed, at the Institute for Advanced Study in Princeton, a research centre, are finding what they call positive geometries, mathematical structures that lie outside space and time. Hoffman calls Arkani-Hamed one of the first pioneers of this work. If he is right, space and time would not be the deepest layer of reality, leaving room for things we normally cannot perceive.
